headline: Jain Irrigation ties up with Supercritical for biochar carbon removal credits
hook: New export revenue stream for Jain Irrigation
summary: Jain Irrigation Systems has signed an agreement with Supercritical for up to 19,000 tonnes of Biochar Carbon Removal Credits. The arrangement involves strategic, technical, manufacturing, or marketing tie-ups related to these carbon credits. Biochar removal credits allow companies to offset emissions by locking carbon into the soil using specialized agricultural processes. Retail investors can track how this emerging green revenue stream impacts the company's export margins and future sustainability earnings.
